non_claims: The side chain is assigned by the precursor composition hypothesis, not by these product ions.
Glucose versus another hexose, oxime geometry and side-chain stereochemistry are not resolved.
Glucosinolates whose side chain is not in the enumerated list, or that carry extra sugar or acyl groups, do not enter the precondition.

notes: HSO4- plus at least one thioglucose-derived ion follows the Fabre 2007 screening criterion; the 1 % protocol default floor is used (Yang 2026 prints 0.5 only for its networking seed ions), and HSO4-/H2PO4- are separated only at the p2 tolerance.

competitors.note: Other organic sulfates also give HSO4- (Hooshmand 2021, Introduction; Bialecki 2010, p. 272).
H2PO4- and hexose phosphate lie 0.0095 Da (by calculation) from HSO4- and C6H11O9S-; only the p2 tolerance separates them.

priors.note: In negative-mode direct infusion of the standards only the deprotonated glucosinolate ions were seen, with no adduct or degradation ions.
The deprotonated sulfate [M-H]- is the predominant glucosinolate ion in negative ESI.
